defaultPolicy.reason: Mutable product master and transaction tables retain explicit creator and last-updater accountability.

policies.full-audit: Mutable product master or transaction data.
policies.immutable-event: Append-only evidence whose semantic actor and event time are authoritative.
policies.semantic-lifecycle: Runtime state whose domain lifecycle fields are more precise than duplicate CRUD audit fields.
policies.lease: Short-lived concurrency coordination state identified by owner, fencing token and lease timestamps.
policies.projection: Child/projection state whose ownership and lifecycle are recorded by its aggregate root.
policies.sequence: Allocation primitive whose requester and request timestamp are the audit record.
policies.static-contract: Versioned product compatibility/configuration data installed and changed only through controlled SQL lifecycle.
policies.framework: Third-party framework-owned schema whose physical contract must remain vendor/framework compatible.

patterns.reason: Spring Batch JobRepository physical schema is owned by Spring Batch.

cpf_saga_execution.reason: Saga start and state-update timestamps are the authoritative lifecycle.

cpf_saga_step_execution.reason: Saga step creation and latest transition timestamps record its lifecycle.

cpf_saga_manual_action.reason: Each manual recovery action is immutable evidence of its operator and action time.

adm_approval_history.reason: Approval history is append-only evidence; updating a historical decision is prohibited.

adm_maintenance_action.reason: Maintenance command evidence is attributed to its requester and request time.

bat_runtime_instance.reason: Runtime registration, start, heartbeat and update timestamps express the instance lifecycle.

bat_runtime_capability.reason: Capabilities are a cascade-owned projection of the runtime instance registration.

bat_runtime_heartbeat.reason: Heartbeat rows are append-only runtime observations.

bat_runtime_command.reason: Command requester, request time and latest state transition time are authoritative.

bat_runtime_command_attempt.reason: An execution attempt is immutable evidence bounded by start and finish timestamps.

bat_scheduler_lease.reason: Scheduler leadership is concurrency state governed by owner, fencing and lease time.

bat_schedule_trigger.reason: A scheduled trigger is immutable evidence of the intended and recorded fire time.

bat_center_cut_claim.reason: Center-cut claim ownership is governed by runner, fencing and lease timestamps.

bat_center_cut_execution.reason: Requester and execution lifecycle timestamps are authoritative.

bat_center_cut_rate_window.reason: The rate bucket is short-lived coordination state identified by window and last update.

bat_deployment_cell.reason: Deployment-cell desired state is system reconciled; lifecycle timestamps are authoritative.

bat_deployment_instance.reason: Instance placement is a cascade-owned projection of a deployment cell.

bat_deployment_plan.reason: Plan requester and lifecycle timestamps preserve operational accountability.

bat_deployment_lock.reason: Deployment serialization is governed by owner, fencing, acquisition and expiry.

bat_deployment_execution.reason: Deployment execution evidence retains requester, approver and lifecycle timestamps.

bat_deployment_instance_result.reason: Per-instance deployment result is append-only evidence.

bat_version_compatibility.reason: Compatibility rows are controlled product configuration changed through SQL lifecycle.

bat_job_pack.reason: Job-pack ownership and last registration time form the catalog lifecycle.

bat_job_pack_job.reason: Job entries are a cascade-owned projection of their immutable job-pack manifest.

mbr_member_no_sequence.reason: The allocation request itself is the immutable audit record.

mbr_member_no_issue_history.reason: Member-number issuance is immutable evidence of issuer and issue time.

mbr_member_role_operation.reason: Idempotent role-operation evidence records initiator, request time and completion time.

bza_audit_chain_lock.reason: The single audit-chain head records the actor and time of the last serialized update.
